<reason>A built the cleaner path: concentrated stratospheric harm, tourism-versus-spaceflight, and a live scale fork that B never fully occupied. B’s consistency and no-lien framing were real, but “the passenger pays” did not discharge the motion once A bit the luxury bullet and cashed B’s “tens of flights” as too small to buy the claimed industrial benefit. A’s criterion was slightly unstable on concerts and polar travel, and the clipped R2 was a cost, yet A still left the easier vote.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>A’s Rebuttal 1 fork: tourism cannot be a climate rounding error and the thing that thickens launch cadence; later weighed against B’s “tens of flights a year.”</best_rebuttal>
